# Premier Healthcare

> > Premier Healthcare supplies professional medical equipment, surgical instruments, PPE, and infection control products for healthcare facilities.

Premier Healthcare (premierhh.co.uk) is a UK-based medical supplies distributor offering sterile surgical instruments from manufacturers like Swann Morton and Terumo, disposable PPE including latex and powder-free gloves, patient handling equipment, wound care products, and foot care treatments. Products comply with EN standards and British Pharmacopoeia specifications for healthcare settings.

## Key Topics

- Premier Healthcare
- Swann Morton surgical blades
- Carbon steel scalpel blades
- Sterile surgical instruments
- Latex gloves and powder-free gloves
- Disposable examination gloves
- EN374-2 and EN374-3 compliance
- Infection control products
- Patient handling equipment
- Foot care and callus treatment
- Gehwol med products
- BP and EN 14079 standards
- Medical-grade PPE
- Wound care supplies
- Healthcare equipment
